description_en: Queries user information by Alibaba Cloud ID or Alibaba Cloud account name
description_zh: 根据阿里云ID或阿里云账户名查询用户信息
name: QueryUserInfoByAccount

parameters.help_en:
The Alibaba Cloud account name or Alibaba Cloud ID to query.
When you enter an account name:
    - If the organization user is a primary account (for example, main_account), the query account format is the primary account. That is, enter the primary account main_account. 
    - If the organization user is a RAM user (for example, zhangsan@test.onaliyun.com), the query account format is the prefix of the RAM user. That is, enter zhangsan.
When you enter an Alibaba Cloud ID:
    - Enter the complete account UID to query the corresponding account information
parameters.help_zh:
输入待查询的阿里云账号名或阿里云ID。
当输入账号名时：
    - 如果组织用户是主账号（例如main_account），则查询账号格式为主账号。即，要输入的主账号main_account。 
    - 如果组织用户是子账号（例如zhangsan@test.onaliyun.com），则查询账号格式为子账号的头部，即，要输入的子账号为zhangsan。
当输入阿里云ID时：
    - 输入完整的账号UID，即可查询到对应的账号信息
parameters.name: account

parameters.help_en: The account name of the primary account when a duplicate error occurs during RAM user query. For example, zhangsan@test.onaliyun.com
parameters.help_zh:
当查询子账号出现重复报错时，输入主账号的账号名，
例如zhangsan@test.onaliyun.com
parameters.name: parent_account_name

AccountId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID. For users who are not added through RAM self-service reading, the Alibaba Cloud ID can be obtained only after logon
AccountId.description_zh: 阿里云账号ID。非Ram自助读取添加的用户，需要登录后才能获取到阿里云ID

AccountName.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account name. For RAM users, the domain name after the at sign (@) is removed. For example, test@test.com returns test
AccountName.description_zh: 阿里云账号名称。（子账号会去除@后面的域名信息，例如test@test.com，会返回test）
